g.text: Eviction pipeline — pressure band → urgency → queue → async thread → quiescence → LRU select → unswizzle
skip if too recent or > 5 s stale
score by LRU coldness, take coldest
The eviction thread NEVER blocks client inserts/lookups: it runs in the
background, holds only a Weak<Coordinator>, and only evicts nodes whose disk
image is current — a write invalidates the DiskLocationRegistry until the next
